title: Evaluation of the Inflammatory Secretome of Astrocytes Using Cytokine Array
author: Elena Coccia
materials: Open the acquired images in Fiji software. Use the 'Analyze' function to measure the intensity of each spot. Subtract background intensity and normalize to internal positive control spots.
Open the acquired images in Fiji software. Use the 'Analyze' function to measure the intensity of each spot. Subtract background intensity and normalize to internal positive control spots.

steps.title: Seed astrocytes in 6-well plates
steps.instruction: Plate astrocytes at 2 × 10⁵ cells per well in 2 mL astrocyte medium in 6‑well plates; incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 48 h until confluent.

steps.title: Condition cells in serum‑free medium
steps.instruction: After 48 h, aspirate the medium, add 2 mL fresh serum‑free medium, and incubate for an additional 4 days. Then collect the conditioned media and centrifuge at 1 200 rpm for 5 min to remove debris.

steps.title: Perform cytokine array
steps.instruction: Follow the manufacturer’s cytokine array protocol. Block the membrane with blocking buffer for 1 h at room temperature, dilute conditioned media 1:2 with sample diluent, apply 100 µL to each membrane, and incubate overnight at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Block membrane with blocking buffer for 1 h at RT
Dilute conditioned media 1:2 with sample diluent

steps.title: Detect and visualize array
steps.instruction: Wash membranes three times with wash buffer (5 min each). Add HRP‑conjugated detection antibody and incubate 1 h at room temperature. Wash again three times (5 min each), add chemiluminescent substrate, and capture the signal with an imaging system.

substeps.instruction: Wash 3× with wash buffer, 5 min each
Add HRP‑conjugated detection antibody, incubate 1 h at RT

steps.title: Quantify spot intensity
steps.instruction: Measure the integrated optical density of each array spot using Fiji software.
